mermaid-browser.svg and sequence-browser.svg were downloaded from the real
Lernium editor through its visible Download SVG action during browser acceptance
on 2026-10-22. They are the synthetic QA course's flowchart and local PlantUML
sequence diagram. Browser text measurement/layout is intact, unlike the earlier
JSDOM fixtures. The dark preview colors differ from PDF's print theme only.

The regression reproduced in the actual course PDF: missing arrowheads and
nested em-positioned tspan labels collapsed across node borders. Tests compare
real rendered PDF pixels with and without marker references at each endpoint,
check glyph bounds, and retain vector rendering. No customer data or credentials
are present in these fixtures.
